body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Plantronics introduced 'SAVI TALK 430', wireless headset for laptop and netbook at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA for 4 days from January 6.
'SAVI TALK 430' is high-tech wireless headset system which can use connecting with netbook or laptop supporting Bluetooth and designed for phone call during moving within a 50m radius.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
